mapper.sql: app_id, msg_data_id, index_in_msg, article_id, article_title, article_url, user_comment_id, openid, content, comment_type, comment_time, reply_content, reply_time, status, contact_id, synced_at

ON CONFLICT (app_id, msg_data_id, index_in_msg, user_comment_id) DO UPDATE SET article_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.article_id, crm_wechat_mp_article_comment.article_id), article_title = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.article_title, crm_wechat_mp_article_comment.article_title), article_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.article_url, crm_wechat_mp_article_comment.article_url), openid = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.openid, crm_wechat_mp_article_comment.openid), content = EXCLUDED.content, comment_type = EXCLUDED.comment_type, comment_time = EXCLUDED.comment_time, reply_content = EXCLUDED.reply_content, reply_time = EXCLUDED.reply_time, status = EXCLUDED.status, contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wechat_mp_article_comment.contact_id), synced_at = now(), updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, cfg.account_name AS account_name, ct.name AS contact_name, f.nickname AS nickname, f.avatar_url AS avatar_url FROM crm_wechat_mp_article_comment c LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_config cfg ON cfg.app_id = c.app_id LEFT JOIN crm_contact ct ON ct.contact_id = c.contact_id LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_fan f ON f.app_id = c.app_id AND c.openid IS NOT NULL AND c.openid <> '' AND f.open_id = c.openid WHERE c.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_time = #{replyTime}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET reply_content = NULL, reply_time = NULL, status = 'pending', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET comment_type = #{commentType}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET is_read = true, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET contact_id = CASE WHEN #{touchContact} THEN #{contactId} ELSE contact_id END, lead_id = CASE WHEN #{touchLead} THEN #{leadId} ELSE lead_id END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wechat_mp_article_comment SET review_required = true, auto_reply_rule_id = #{ruleId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, cfg.account_name AS account_name, NULL::varchar AS contact_name, NULL::varchar AS nickname, NULL::varchar AS avatar_url FROM crm_wechat_mp_article_comment c LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_config cfg ON cfg.app_id = c.app_id WHERE c.status = 'pending' AND COALESCE(c.review_required, false) = false ORDER BY c.comment_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
